hero.title: Learn to meditate within a real tradition
hero.subtitle: Niela teaches you the basics of Zen or Christian contemplation from scratch. And when you're ready, it prepares meditations for whatever you are going through.

idea.title: Meditation is not one single thing
idea.text: Most apps give you the same thing: breathe, relax, sleep. But meditation was born inside traditions with centuries of history, each with its own path. In Niela you choose one and learn where your practice comes from, why it works and how to practise it properly.

traditions.title: Choose your path
traditions.zenText: Presence, breath and silence. The practice of sitting and being, as it is taught in Zen monasteries.
traditions.christianText: Silent prayer, meditative reading and inner stillness. The meditation Christians have practised for more than a thousand years.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Text: Zen or Christian contemplative, wherever you come from.
how.step2Text: A course of 20 short audio lessons that takes you from scratch.
how.step3Text: Once you know the basics, Niela creates meditations of up to 10 minutes for whatever you are going through that day. If you allow it, it remembers what you tell it so it can accompany you better.

includes.title: Everything included
includes.i2: 4 personalised meditations a month with Niela AI
includes.i3: A journal to record how you feel
includes.i4: A daily reminder at the time you choose
includes.i7: A handwritten welcome letter, posted to your home

privacy.title: Your practice is yours
privacy.p1: Your data is never sold or shared for advertising.
privacy.p2: We ask for your express permission before using your tradition or your journal, and you can withdraw it any time.
privacy.p4: If you are going through a hard time, Niela shows you support resources.
privacy.note: Niela is a wellbeing tool and does not replace medical or psychological care.

founder.title: Who makes Niela
founder.text: I'm Yunior. I live in Italy and I wanted to start meditating, but I didn't know where to begin. Every app told me the same thing and none explained what I was doing or where it came from. That's why I built Niela: so anyone can start from scratch, within a real tradition.
founder.contact: If you have an idea or a problem, write to me:

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need to know how to meditate?
faq.a1: No. Niela is made for people starting from scratch. The course teaches you the basics step by step.
faq.q2: Do I have to be religious to choose the Christian tradition?
faq.a2: No. You can approach any tradition out of curiosity, wherever you come from.
faq.a3: A guide that creates meditations of up to 10 minutes made for your day. It includes 4 a month and activates with your first payment.
faq.q4: How does the free trial work?
faq.a4: You get 30 days with the full course. When it ends the subscription is charged, unless you cancel first from your Apple account.
faq.a5: Yes, in your Apple account settings, whenever you want.
faq.q8: What do you do with my data?
faq.a8: We never sell it. We only use your tradition and your journal if you give us express permission, and you can withdraw it any time. More details in the privacy policy.

deleteAccount.metaDesc: How to delete your Niela account and all your data, from the app or by email.
deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your Niela account whenever you like. When you do, we erase your personal data permanently: this is not a temporary deactivation and it cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.data1: Your account: email, name and password.
deleteAccount.data2: Your sign-up answers: tradition, goals, duration and notes.
deleteAccount.data3: Your journal, saved meditations and course progress.
deleteAccount.data4: Your postal address, if you gave one for the welcome letter.
deleteAccount.data5: Your AI credits and the usage history tied to your account.
deleteAccount.opt1Desc: This is the quickest way and takes effect immediately:
deleteAccount.opt2Desc: If you no longer have access to the app, write to us at
deleteAccount.opt2WithSubject: with the subject “Delete my Niela account”.
deleteAccount.opt2Details: Write from the same email address you signed up with, so we can confirm the account is yours. We reply within 30 days at the latest, usually much sooner.
deleteAccount.legalNote: Your subscription is managed through your Apple or Google ID: deleting the account does not cancel it. We keep invoices for 10 years as Italian tax law requires, and use them for nothing else.
